Name: Valley Admin
Author: OHHHlevix
Description:
Valley Admin
[b]Take full control of your Stardew Valley experience with Valley Admin![/b]
Valley Admin is a comprehensive administrative command system for Stardew Valley, designed to give players greater control over their farms, characters, inventory, world and gameplay mechanics.
Featuring a custom administrative console and a quick command interface, Valley Admin provides a centralized way to manage your game through an extensive collection of commands.
[heading]Features[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]Custom Admin Console:[/b] A dedicated interface for executing commands and viewing their results.[/*]
[*][b]Quick Commands:[/b] Execute commands quickly without opening the full console.[/*]
[*][b]Autocomplete:[/b] Get command and argument suggestions while typing.[/*]
[*][b]Command History:[/b] Easily access previously executed commands.[/*]
[*][b]Modular Command System:[/b] Commands organized into categories for easier navigation and expansion.[/*]
[*][b]Admin Permissions:[/b] Administrative access control for command execution.[/*]
[*][b]Custom Configuration:[/b] Personalize keyboard shortcuts and interface behavior.[/*]
[/list][heading]Command Categories[/heading]
Valley Admin includes several command categories:
[list]
[*][b]Player:[/b] Manage health, energy, movement speed and player properties.[/*]
[*][b]Items:[/b] Give, remove, search and manage inventory items.[/*]
[*][b]Economy:[/b] Add, remove and modify player money.[/*]
[*][b]World:[/b] Control time, weather, seasons and days.[/*]
[*][b]Farm:[/b] Manage animals, buildings, crops and farm resources.[/*]
[*][b]NPCs:[/b] Inspect characters, manage friendships and teleport.[/*]
[*][b]Skills:[/b] Manage skill levels and experience.[/*]
[*][b]Environment:[/b] Control environmental elements and world resources.[/*]
[*][b]Advanced:[/b] Teleportation, spawning, duplication, effects and custom game rules.[/*]
[*][b]Administration:[/b] Access configuration, diagnostics, version information and command history.[/*]
[/list][heading]User Interface[/heading]
Valley Admin features two complementary interfaces:
[b]Quick Command[/b]
A compact command input designed for fast execution, featuring autocomplete and command suggestions.
[b]Admin Console[/b]
A dedicated administrative window featuring command history, execution feedback, informational messages and error notifications.
Both interfaces share the same command system.
[heading]Compatibility[/heading]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/*]
[*]SMAPI[/*]
[*]Designed with modularity and future expansions in mind.[/*]
[/list][heading]Development[/heading]
Valley Admin is designed as an expandable project. Its modular architecture allows new commands and administrative features to be introduced without restructuring the entire system.
More commands and improvements may be introduced in future updates.
